# Person Information Model

> A LinkML model for people, organizations and their relationships. Used to test **OntoReview**'s LinkML support.

- Ontology IRI: https://w3id.org/example/personinfo
- Namespace: https://w3id.org/example/personinfo/ (prefix `personinfo:`)
- Version: 0.3.0
- License: CC0 1.0 (Public Domain)
- Contents: 6 classes, 5 object properties, 8 datatype properties, 1 datatype, 4 named individuals

Terms are identified by IRI; use the CURIEs and labels below when writing SPARQL or RDF.

## Documentation

- [Overview](index.md): metadata and contents
- [Classes](classes.md): 6 classes with definitions and axioms
- [Object properties](object-properties.md): 5 object properties with definitions and axioms
- [Datatype properties](datatype-properties.md): 8 datatype properties with definitions and axioms
- [Datatypes](datatypes.md): 1 datatype with definitions and axioms
- [Named individuals](individuals.md): 4 named individuals with definitions and axioms

## Machine-readable

- [ontology.json](ontology.json): all terms as JSON (IRI, label, definition, hierarchy, domain/range)
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): the complete documentation as one Markdown file
- [Turtle](ontology.ttl): the ontology source (text/turtle)
- [RDF/XML](ontology.owl): the ontology source (application/rdf+xml)
- [JSON-LD](ontology.jsonld): the ontology source (application/ld+json)
- [N-Triples](ontology.nt): the ontology source (application/n-triples)
